claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tianeptine is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM; its only plausible cytotoxic liability is mitochondrial beta-oxidation inhibition, which is a chronic hepatotoxicity mechanism rather than an acute antiproliferative effect in cancer cell lines.
